name: Utah 4-H Mock Legislature
city: Utah State Capitol, Salt Lake City, UT
what_you_do: Study bills, present one in committee and debate it on the House floor of the Utah State Capitol.
who_can_apply: 4-H youth in 9th to 12th grade. Adults also attend.
deadline_text: 2026 event was April 22, 2026. 2027 date not posted.
how_to_apply: Register on Zsuite (4h.zsuite.org). Questions: contact the Utah 4-H State Office at 435-797-4444 or your county 4-H office.
notes: Held with Rep. Joel Briscoe and the Office of Legislative Research.
